statement_paraphrase: 'Next year for sure, we'll have over a million robotaxis on the road' (fast-forward a year, maybe a year and three months)
contradicting_event: No robotaxi fleet in 2020. California DMV filed accusations (public 2022-08-05) that Autopilot/FSD marketing was misleading; an ALJ ruled the marketing deceptive on 2025-12-16 (suspension stayed; Tesla later dropped 'Autopilot' wording)
stock_reaction: TSLA 2019-04-23: -0.46% vs SPY (statement); 2022-08-05: -6.63% raw, -6.46% vs SPY (DMV news, confounded by macro day); 2025-12-16: +3.34% vs SPY (ALJ ruling, no negative reaction)
safe_wording: Musk's 2019 prediction of over a million robotaxis by 2020 did not materialize; California's DMV later challenged, and a judge found deceptive, Tesla's Autopilot/FSD marketing (the ruling addressed marketing generally, not this quote).
